tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: Logo forest. The brand's anchor colour: primary buttons, headings with brand weight, and the cover slab in light theme. Never recolour the logo away from it.

tokens.name: forest-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed and hover state of forest fills; deep bands in marketing layouts.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Logo mint. Accent fills only: the verified dot, highlights, chart emphasis, and primary action in dark theme. Fails as text on light surfaces (2.2:1), so never set text in it on white.

tokens.name: mint-bright
tokens.usage: Mint lifted for dark surfaces: brand text and verified text on dark grounds.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, menus and dialogs. In light theme it matches surface, so cards are set apart by a line border.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, table headers, code and read-only fields.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (15.8:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels and metadata, on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and neutral-soft (5.6:1 or better).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative only; never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and checkbox borders; meets 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary action fill and selected state. Forest in light theme, mint in dark.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill (10.5:1 light, 7.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for brand buttons.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Brand-coloured text and links, on surface, surface-raised and verified-soft.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Mint accent fill: verified dot, progress, chart highlight. Not for text on light grounds.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent (mint) fill (7.4:1).

tokens.name: verified-soft
tokens.usage: Background of verified badges and success callouts.

tokens.name: verified-ink
tokens.usage: Text on verified-soft (9.5:1 light, 8.3:1 dark). Always paired with the word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of in-review and needs-info badges and callouts.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Text on warning-soft (6.2:1 light, 8.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of not-verified badges, errors and destructive callouts.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Error text on danger-soft, surface and surface-raised (6.6:1 light, 7.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: neutral-soft
tokens.usage: Background of expired and neutral badges; ink-muted text reads on it.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px. Meets 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Marketing hero headlines only; one per page.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Section heroes and key numbers on marketing pages.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We check your linked accounts against the SEC net-worth test, excluding your primary residence.
styles.usage: Default body copy and form text.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Statements must be dated within the last 90 days.
styles.usage: Helper text, table cells, dense UI.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, badge text, button text in small buttons.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Small uppercase eyebrows above card titles. The only place text is uppercased.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Passport IDs, API keys, audit hashes and webhook names.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap; badge dot gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside compact groups; badge horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between form label and field; button groups.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between major page regions.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Marketing section spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, checkboxes, small tags. The shield is angular, so corners stay tight.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs and the passport card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status badges only.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Raised buttons on hover. Cards use a line border instead.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and dialogs only.
